name: Back to the Board
description: One student faces away from the board. A word is shown behind them, and teammates give clues until the student guesses it.
subject: English

name: Boot Camp
description: Students complete a series of quick physical or language challenges as a team.
subject: English

name: Charades
description: A student acts out a word or phrase without speaking while others guess.
subject: English

name: Closest to the Dot
description: Students try to place or throw an object as close as possible to a target dot.
subject: English

name: Colder/Warmer
description: Students search for an object while classmates say “warmer” when they get closer and “colder” when they move away.
subject: English

name: Cup Balance/Stack
description: Students balance or stack cups as quickly as possible without knocking them over.
subject: English

name: Cup Flip
description: Students flip plastic cups from the edge of a table until they land upright.
subject: English

description: Students bounce a ping-pong ball into cups. The player/team with the most successful shots wins.
subject: English

name: Cup Pyramids
description: Students race to build and/or dismantle a pyramid of cups.
subject: English

name: Earthquake, Tornado, Surfer, Dancer

subject: English

name: Fast Flip
description: Students race to flip an object, usually a cup, according to the given instructions.
subject: English

name: Fill in the Blank
description: Students complete missing words in sentences or phrases.
subject: English

subject: English

name: Hot Potato

subject: English

name: Horse Race

subject: English

name: Jenga Block Stack

subject: English

name: Jeopardy

subject: English

name: Killer Pizza

subject: English

name: Lingo
description: Students guess words using clues, letters, or previous guesses.
subject: English

name: Listen and Circle
description: Students listen carefully and circle the correct word, picture, or answer.
subject: English

subject: English

name: Mario
description: Students advance through levels/challenges by answering questions or completing tasks, similar to a game adventure.
subject: English

name: MASH

subject: English

subject: English

subject: English

subject: English

subject: English

subject: English

name: Roll and Say

subject: English

name: Run, Rabbit, Run

subject: English

subject: English

subject: English

subject: English

subject: English

subject: English

subject: English

name: Spell, Sentence, Draw

description: Move around; when the teacher says “Stop,” read the nearest card.

subject: English

name: Tic Tac Throw

subject: English

name: Throw and Clap

subject: English

name: What’s in the Fridge?
description: Identify or guess the food items in the fridge.
subject: English

name: Who’s Fast?
description: Race to give the correct answer or touch the correct card first.
subject: English

name: Equation detectives
subject: Mathematics
description: Teams find and correct a deliberate error in a worked example; justify every correction.

name: Fraction market
subject: Mathematics
description: Trade paper fraction cards to build equivalent totals; explain each exchange.

name: Predict, test, explain
subject: Science
description: Predict a safe classroom demonstration, compare observations, then explain with evidence.

name: Food-web connections
subject: Biology
description: Connect organism cards with feeding relationships and explain the impact of removing one organism.

name: Map mystery
subject: Geography
description: Use map clues and scale to identify a location; justify the route and compare alternatives.

name: Timeline detectives
subject: History
description: Order event cards, use evidence to defend dates, and explain causes and consequences.

name: Code tracing challenge
subject: Computing
description: Trace a short algorithm on paper, predict output, then debug an intentional error.

name: Evidence debate
subject: All subjects
description: Pairs support a claim with evidence; swap roles and identify one limitation.
